description.zh: 兼容 LocalSend，手机电脑互传文件
description.en: Works with LocalSend: send files between phones and computers

description.zh: 和附近开着 LocalSend 的手机、电脑互传文件和文字
description.en: Send files and text to and from phones and computers nearby running LocalSend

hint.zh: 让附近的设备找到这台电脑，发文件过来。每次都会先问你
hint.en: Devices nearby can find this PC and send files. You are asked every time

hint.zh: 别的设备看到的名字；留空用这台电脑的名字
hint.en: The name other devices see; empty for this PC's name

hint.zh: 设了以后，别人要输入它才能发过来；留空不用。存在 Windows 凭据管理器里
hint.en: Others must type it to send to this PC; empty for none. Kept in Windows Credential Manager

title.zh: 专用网络、域网络和这台电脑开的热点（公用网络在「传」里点一下才接收）
title.en: Private and domain networks and this PC's hotspot (a public network once you allow it in the list)

title.zh: 所有网络，包括公用网络
